title: KJI首席：香港市场短期风险与长期催化剂并存
speaker: Cousin Lender

segments.en: Aside from AI, I wonder what is your assessment of risk per se in the back half of the year? I mean, rear-watching and trying to decipher what the Fed is going to do.
segments.zh: 除了AI，您对下半年风险本身的评估是什么？我的意思是，关注美联储动向并试图解读其意图。

segments.en: So, RAGE strategy is on the cards, but aside from that, also trade negotiations between the US and China, how that might pick up? How are you positioning on advising clients?
segments.zh: 所以RAGE策略有可能，但除此之外，中美贸易谈判也可能升温。您如何为客户定位？

segments.en: Yeah, I think I would like to divide that question into two parts. I think in terms of the short-term risk, the one and the largest risk is that because of the underperformance of the Hong Kong China market,
segments.zh: 我想把这个问题分为两部分。短期风险方面，最大的风险是香港及内地市场表现不佳，

segments.en: and that potentially, and together on the back job that the rest of Asia is doing quite well, what we are afraid would be a richer cycle where capital starts to flow out of Hong Kong China,
segments.zh: 加上亚洲其他地区表现良好，我们担心会出现一个恶性循环，资金开始流出香港和内地，

segments.en: and then that richer cycle just keeps the market moving down, just like post-COVID. We have got a couple of years where investors try to avoid the market.
segments.zh: 这个恶性循环导致市场持续下跌，就像疫情后那样。有几年投资者试图避开这个市场。

segments.en: But I think this time there could be two main difference. One is on the development side. Ever since China launched the deep sleep model, I think the development of the technology and the model just keeps going on.
segments.zh: 但我认为这次有两个主要不同。一是发展方面。自从中国推出DeepSeek模型，技术和模型的发展一直在持续。

segments.en: I think that is one main catalyst for the market. We don't know when, but as far as the establishment of that new technology breakthrough, that will be a big catalyst for the market.
segments.zh: 我认为这是市场的一个主要催化剂。我们不知道何时，但一旦这项新技术突破确立，将成为市场的重大催化剂。

segments.en: And therefore, I think that will prevent money from sorting long-term on the market. Secondly, I think very different from a couple of years back,
segments.zh: 因此，我认为这将阻止资金长期远离市场。其次，与几年前非常不同，

segments.en: that is huge amount of IPO into the market, and that will cap the global investor focus into the Hong Kong China market, although short-term there's neck of catalysts.
segments.zh: 大量IPO进入市场，这将吸引全球投资者关注香港和内地市场，尽管短期催化剂不足。
